blip_cause_pooled.calendar: NYSE closures, rule-derived: New Year, MLK, Presidents, Good Friday, Memorial, Juneteenth (from 2022), Independence, Labor, Thanksgiving, Christmas -- plus the three scheduled 13:00 early closes
blip_cause_pooled.hk_calendar: HKEX calendar, measured on the HSI daily series (no bar = Hong Kong did not trade; a bar whose turnover is under 60% of its own trailing-20 median = a half day with no closing valuation). Statutory HK holidays follow the lunar calendar and the exchange also shuts for typhoons, so no rule set names this calendar -- the index does.
blip_cause_pooled.nav_move_basis: largest / 90th percentile over the legs' one-row stamps
blip_cause_pooled.nav_move_ratio_basis: median over legs of each leg's own median

ruler.not_proof: a closed channel is consistent with a standing premium; it is not evidence that the premium is fair, nor a sell signal
ruler.premium: panel close / the newest unit NAV stamped strictly before that close - 1
ruler.status_join: 申购状态 printed on the NAV stamp the premium used
ruler.status_source: EM fund_etf_fund_info_em column 申购状态 (dropped by the NAV cache)

session.sentence: premiums priced on 2026-11-13 against a ticket of 2026-11-13 -- every leg prices the ticket's own session; the price/IOPV column comes from the 2026-11-13 board face (ticket_session)

summary_sentence: 5/5 legs show no open primary subscription anywhere in coverage; exchange-only on their latest stamp: 510760, 512040, 159655, 513690, 159519; the 186 hard-suspended sessions are 99 runs (74 of them a single NAV row); with the 74 one-row valuation gaps removed the block still sits wider on 159519 and not on 159655, 513690; 510760 has no real suspension left at all; 159519's gap sits in its single 3-session run (own gap +2.58) while its other 21 runs read -0.01; the single-row runs are not spread over the calendar: Tue carries 43% of them against 20% of priced sessions (chance 6e-06), so a one-row word is a word printed that session, not a fund policy; what those one-row words are is a valuation gap, not an announcement: 74/74 of them suspend 赎回 on the same row, they move the NAV by 0.16 of a normal session (median), and 45/74 sit on a session the HKEX calendar explains against 5.9% of ordinary sessions (10.2x); closed channel is consistent with a standing premium, not a verdict on it
